review.reviewer: Codex attach_core subagent reviewing primary-agent draft
review.notes: Independent review against native drivers, actual fixture assertions and accepted PLAN.md. All original nine obligations and six backend/origin combinations remain required. Explicit sub-boundaries expose missing FAKE-IP, fault, resource, terminal, unload and throughput coverage. Mutable source snapshot is a draft, not the release freeze; no execution or valid measurements are inferred. Required trust-root/cold-start/history-integrity and Windows MSYS/Cygwin fork boundaries are explicitly planned; no native exec equivalence is assumed.

boundaries.description: Linux ptrace attach and detach proposals have no policy side effects before approval.
Linux Gum attach and detach proposals have no policy side effects before approval.
Windows Gum attach and detach proposals have no policy side effects before approval.
Reject altered process identity, scope, policy, capabilities, executor, Bootstrap, Host identity and recovery bindings.
Reject future, exactly expired and expired grants; consume each nonce once for its OS claimant.
Runtime envelope/API authority cannot derive the administrator signing key or claim implicit external run ownership.
Password/config-generation changes immediately invalidate old signers, preserve consumed audit and retain encrypted recovery readability.
Linux Host OS peer authentication rejects wrong server PID before credentials/proofs are sent.
Windows named-pipe OS peer authentication rejects wrong server PID before credentials/proofs are sent.
Refuse configured TLS/SSH interception unsupported by existing contexts without weakening configuration.
Core verification uses an enrolled in-memory approval key; ordinary verifier-file replacement cannot register or change the root.
Every Host pins its initial approval root; no command or ordinary file may lazily choose a different first root.
API-only cold startup stays Unenrolled for external lifecycle mutation while ordinary Serve/policy/run startup remains usable.
First real administrator approve completes challenge-bound registration via authenticated trusted CLI code, then the exact original request without another password prompt.
Password changes require contiguous instance/generation-bound old-key-signed rotation records; missing/reordered/backward or untrusted chains never replace a pinned root.
Consumed/completion history must be rooted in trusted accepted-operation state; an ordinary writable ledger key snapshot cannot alone authorize continuation.

A Draining/resident slot that becomes terminal during human review receives fresh request/attachment/session/token epochs without changing target/scope/backend/policy or repeating approval; clients follow the actual returned id.

Windows approved tree denies post-commit child exec and at least ten fresh native child reads.
Measure children alive or in-flight across the actual Windows commit boundary; no reset may hide post-commit allowed work.
Already running target threads and concurrent thread creation cannot escape at attach/detach boundaries on every backend.
Owned Linux ptrace run returns root exit 37 promptly while its survivor remains managed and can be detached.
Owned Linux Gum run returns root exit 37 promptly while its survivor remains managed and can be detached.
Windows keeper preserves descendant enforcement and detach after original root exit.
Native Windows lifecycle and approved tree cover MSYS/Cygwin fork/clone shared-memory rebuild and metadata/Host identity rebinding; native Rust exec fixtures do not cover this ABI boundary.
fork/clone/rebuild descendants preserve the accepted detach cutoff and cannot replay an older/equal-time Attach to reactivate policy.
